exposure: initiation of breastfeeding in the hospital
outcome: Breastfeeding duration (specifically, breastfeeding for 2 months or longer)
cohort: The study included 2,013 women from Utah and Wyoming who recently had a live birth and were surveyed on BFHI practices.
finding: Initiating breastfeeding in the hospital was significantly associated with breastfeeding for 2 months or longer.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in 2016 using the Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System (PRAMS) survey for women who had recently experienced a live birth.
